correctness.rationale: Matched scalar delta jumps yield unimodular U(b)P U(a), and CPA iff its M11 vanishes. Positivity forces exactly the L=1 integer-pi or L>1 half-integer-pi branches. The rank-one S singular value gives 1-max output fraction equal to 2(L-1)/L^2 on the overcritical branch and zero at criticality; differentiation gives unique L=2 and the two ordered splits. The associated separate verifier independently checks 4,743 finite test assertions, not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A two-sided CPA that absorbs one tailored illumination exactly can still leak strongly for other coherent inputs. Optimizing the minimum absorbed fraction across every input, under exact CPA and two strictly positive lossy point sheets, supplies a motivated robustness performance figure. The theorem yields an exact feasibility and spacing transition, a unique unequal allocation at each overcritical budget, and a globally sharp 50% guaranteed-absorption ceiling at a uniquely tuned total loss. The 50% guarantee differs conceptually from the textbook one-sided 50% absorption bound of a single thin sheet.
